high_pressure_intake_pump: must ramp up at a maximum rate of 0.5 bar per minute to prevent membrane telescoping

anti_scalant_dosing_pump: must be energized and verified active prior to raw water valve actuation

main_feed_breaker: must be tripped immediately if catastrophic seal failure occurs

permeate_conductivity: If fails to drop below baseline within 20 minutes, immediately execute the shutdown sequence mandated by [OP-SD-001]

personnel: Operators must wear nitrile gloves and splash goggles when handling sodium bisulfite

dosing_skid_containment_bund: must be pumped empty within 4 hours of any detected spill

empty_chemical_carboys: require a triple rinse with permeate water before disposal

membrane_feed_pressure: critical low trip occurs at 50.0 bar
critical high trip forces shutdown at 60.0 bar

water_quality_data: retention of all water quality data for a period spanning ten years
